questions.prompt: The Spanish Armada sailed in 1588 against which country?
questions.fact: Storms scattering the fleet on its retreat around Scotland and Ireland destroyed more ships than the fighting did.

questions.prompt: What is the boiling point of water at sea level in Celsius?
questions.fact: It falls with altitude, which is why cooking instructions differ in mountain regions.

questions.prompt: Alpine skiing's downhill discipline is primarily a test of what?
questions.fact: Racers regularly exceed 130 kilometres per hour, and each competitor normally gets a single run.

questions.prompt: Which platform is built around live streaming, particularly of video games?
questions.fact: It began as a general life-streaming site before the gaming section outgrew everything else and took over.

questions.prompt: Which body of water separates Alaska from Russia?
questions.fact: At its narrowest two islands sit about four kilometres apart, with the international date line running between them.
